rationale: Fire damage to the policyholder's own kitchen cabinets and walls is clearly property damage to covered residential property, with no liability or third-party involvement.
claim_summary: Homeowners claim for kitchen fire damage caused by grease flare-up on stove. Policyholder extinguished fire with extinguisher. Damage includes charred kitchen cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries. Fire confined to kitchen area. Deductible: $500. Coverage limit: $250,000.

case_facts.description: fire started from grease flare-up on stove; extinguished with fire extinguisher
case_facts.damage: charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls
case_facts.property_extent: damage limited to kitchen area; rest of house unaffected

rationale: Damage is isolated to the policyholder's own basement property, including structural elements (flooring, drywall) and personal property stored there, with no indication of third-party involvement or vehicle involvement.
claim_summary: Basement flooding with approximately 2 inches of water across entire basement. Hardwood flooring buckled, drywall soaked up to 1 foot, and stored boxes ruined. Discovered upon claimant's return from work trip. High-severity property damage claim requiring structural assessment and contents evaluation. Deductible: $500; Coverage Limit: $750,000.

case_facts.description: approximately two inches of water across entire basement; hardwood floor buckled; drywall soaked up to one foot high; stored boxes ruined
case_facts.claimant_presence: discovered upon return from work trip
